auth.phoneHelp: We'll send you a 6-digit code by SMS. Your number is never shown to anyone.

consent.title: Before you start

points.phone: Your phone number is used only to log in. It is never shown to anyone.
points.location: We check your location only to confirm you are inside the restaurant. It is never shown to anyone.
points.anonymous: Others see only your IntroChat name and your interests.
points.chats: Your chats are deleted when your visit ends, unless you have a subscription.
points.adults: IntroChat is only for people aged 18 and over.

consent.agree: I am 18 or older and I agree to this.

profile.title: About you
profile.birthYearHelp: You must be 18 or older. This can't be changed later.

tags.title: What are you into?
tags.help: Pick 1 to {{max}} interests. People who share them see you first.
tags.invalid: Use up to 24 letters, numbers or spaces.
tags.limitReached: You can pick up to {{max}}. Remove one to add another.

ready.title: You're {{handle}}
ready.body: This is the name people here will see. Your phone number stays private.

underAge.title: Sorry, IntroChat is for adults only
underAge.body: You must be 18 or older to use IntroChat.

notAGuest.title: You're logged in as an admin
notAGuest.body: This browser is logged in to the Admin Console. Log out to continue as a guest.

push.askBody: Even when IntroChat is closed. Notifications never show what anyone wrote.
push.installBody: Notifications work once IntroChat is on your Home Screen:
push.installStep1: Tap Share (the square with an arrow) at the bottom of Safari.
push.installStep3: Open IntroChat from your Home Screen and scan your table again.

sessionFinalPrompt.title: Your time is up
sessionFinalPrompt.body: Open IntroChat in the next 2 minutes to continue.

entry.title: Join {{venue}}
entry.body: Entry here is paid. Choose one:
entry.subscriptionHelp: 2 hours per scan, at any IntroChat restaurant. Your chats are kept while you have scans.
entry.secure: Paid securely through Razorpay (UPI, cards, wallets). IntroChat never sees your card or UPI details.

safety.blockBody: You won't see each other here or anywhere again, and your chat is deleted for both of you. This can't be undone.
safety.reportBody: Our team will see your recent chat with them. They are also blocked: you won't see each other again.
safety.blocked: Blocked. You won't see each other again.
safety.reported: Thank you. Our team will review it, and you won't see each other again.

account.confirmBody: Your profile, interests, chats and any unused scans are deleted within 30 days. Payment records are kept for accounting, without your name. You can cancel until then.
account.pending: You asked to delete your account on {{date}}. It will be done within 30 days.
